digest.component_or_area: reconciler coordinator outcome versioning and state lifecycle
propositions: Versioned lifecycle, retry, and fuse outcome sections must be finalized with exact pass tallies, cursor behavior, and redacted diagnostics while preserving existing mutation fields and hash as immutable.

Cursor, baseline, and binding state must advance only after proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit_unknown work must remain ineligible for advancement and re-observable on subsequent passes.
The repair_at_write_boundary call must execute after under-lock staleness validation and before the first remote issue fetch to prevent race between durable retirement intent and fresh observation.
mutations_applied must be unfolded from the legacy build_pass_tally fold (which combines applied and recovered) so that five reported tally buckets remain disjoint and sum exactly to mutation_count.
Existing mutation fields, array bytes, and canonical hash must remain unchanged; additive versioned sections must be ignorable by older readers.
reconcile.py must remain within the 800-line cap without raising the limit via behavior-preserving extraction along existing call-graph seams.
